description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a client token. Make sure that a unique client token is used for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence?](~~25693~~)

description.zh: 专有宿主机的编号列表。最多可以输入100个预付费专有宿主机ID。多个专有宿主机ID用一个格式类似`["dh-xxxxxxxxx", "dh-yyyyyyyyy", … "dh-zzzzzzzzz"]`的JSON数组表示，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of dedicated hosts. You can specify the IDs of up to 100 subscription dedicated hosts. Specify the dedicated host IDs in a JSON array. Example: `["dh-xxxxxxxxx", "dh-yyyyyyyyy", … "dh-zzzzzzzzz"]`. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
续费周期。取值范围：

<props="china">
- PeriodUnit=Week时：1、2、3、4。
- PeriodUnit=Month时：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36、48、60。
- PeriodUnit=Year时：1、2、3、4、5。

</props>

<props="intl">
- PeriodUnit=Month时：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36、48、60。
- PeriodUnit=Year时：1、2、3、4、5。

</props>
description.en:
The renewal duration. Valid values:

- Valid values when the PeriodUnit parameter is set to Month: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60.

- Valid values when the PeriodUnit parameter is set to Year: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.

description.zh:
续费时长单位。取值范围：

<props="china">
- Week
- Month
- Year

</props>

<props="intl">
- Month
- Year

</props>

默认值：Month。
description.en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

- Month

- Year

Default value: Month.

description.zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 续费一台或者多台包年包月专有宿主机

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

<props="china">续费付款时，优先使用可抵扣的代金券，且您的账号必须支持账号余额支付或信用支付。</props>
<props="intl">续费付款时，优先使用可抵扣的代金券，且您的账号必须支持账号余额支付或信用支付。</props>
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

When you renew subscription dedicated hosts, vouchers are used first by default. Make sure that your account supports credit card payments or balance payments.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs renew-dedicated-hosts --dedicated-host-ids dh-bp199lyny9b30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 1 --period-unit Month --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
